title: Add fetchMinusOvtADDocIdsFromDB function
description: Add a new function to fetch ADTRANS DocIds for employees with MINUS_OVT (Kurang Bayar Overtime) in Venus payroll. Steps: 1) Fetch Venus payroll data, 2) Filter employees where sync.lembur.venusDetail.minusOvt > 0, 3) Query PR_ADTRANS for those employees with lembur description, 4) Return DocIds and employee details

tasks.detail: Create function that fetches Venus payroll and filters for MINUS_OVT
Join PR_ADTRANS and PR_ADTRANSLN to find DocIds with overtime
Return docIds, details, employees array with breakdown
